User story: As a plant beginner, I want to understand what the app does before I add anything so that I know it is worth my time.
As a plant beginner, I want to add my first plant by typing its name so that I can start tracking it in under a minute.
As a plant beginner, I want to pick my plant from a list of common houseplants so that I get a sensible watering schedule without guessing.
Notes: Only 4 species in the list so far.

User story: As a busy gardener, I want to see all my plants and which ones are thirsty today so that I water the right ones first.
As a busy gardener, I want to mark a plant as watered in one tap so that logging never feels like a chore.
As a busy gardener, I want to see how often I watered a plant so that I can spot over- or under-watering.
Notes: Screen exists but shows a raw list, no chart.

User story: As a plant beginner, I want to see light and water tips for my plant so that I give it the right care.
Notes: Light tip only; no watering-amount tip.

User story: As a busy gardener, I want to remove a plant I no longer own so that my list stays relevant.
Notes: Swipe-to-delete works but asks for no confirmation.

User story: As a busy gardener, I want to set a custom reminder time for each plant so that reminders fit my day.
As a plant beginner, I want to get a push reminder when a plant is thirsty so that I do not have to remember anything.
Notes: Push delivery not checked on a device after the last release.

User story: As a busy gardener, I want to snooze a reminder for a day so that I am not nagged when it rains.
Notes: Snooze row on the Reminders screen is a disabled placeholder.

User story: As a busy gardener, I want to change the default reminder time for all plants so that I set it once.
As a busy gardener, I want to invite a plant sitter to my garden so that my plants survive my holiday.
As a friend who waters plants while the owner is away, I want to see which plants to water this week so that I do not have to ask the owner.
As a friend who waters plants while the owner is away, I want to tick plants off and notify the owner so that the owner knows everything is fine.
As a busy gardener, I want to export my plants and watering log so that my data is never locked in.
Notes: Code exists; never run against real data.
